defects: Adds two extra hypotheses (a0 ∈ f.support, b0 ∈ g.support) that are not part of the gold's UniqueMul hypothesis; the gold theorem holds even when a0 ∉ f.support or b0 ∉ g.support (both sides vanish), so these added hypotheses strictly restrict the scope of the produced theorem compared to gold.
Strengthens the algebraic structure requirement from [Mul A] (gold) to [Monoid G], an unnecessary restriction not needed for the statement.
Adds an unnecessary [DecidableEq G] typeclass assumption not present in the gold statement.
